# A read at a negative constant offset is rewritten while every index it reads can
# be zero or more. When an index is a negative constant, the first one in a loop
# with a constant start (a[i-1] from 0) or every one in a loop with a constant limit
# (a[i-16] in a loop that stops before 16), the scalar loop panics when it runs and
# the vector loop would index at a negative constant, which does not compile, so the
# loop is left alone. The rewritten package must build.

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

loopvec -split .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go build .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func FirstIndexZeroConstant(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 15; i < 31; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-15] + 1
	}
}

func EveryIndexNegative(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-16] + 1
	}
}

func FarBelow(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-20] * a[i]
	}
}

func FirstIndexNegative(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}

func FirstIndexZero(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := 1; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}
-- stdout.want --
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":4,"func":"FirstIndexZeroConstant","vectorized":true}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":10,"func":"EveryIndexNegative","vectorized":false,"reason":"a constant offset puts an index below zero","stage":"lower"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":16,"func":"FarBelow","vectorized":false,"reason":"a constant offset puts an index below zero","stage":"lower"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":22,"func":"FirstIndexNegative","vectorized":false,"reason":"a constant offset puts an index below zero","stage":"lower"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":28,"func":"FirstIndexZero","vectorized":true}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 2 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
